Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL1255161, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
